caption: Building with foam + cement: the low-cost panel system transforming what's possible with basic materials. Lightweight. Insulating. Field-tested in Puerto Vallarta. Full guide on Infinite Architecture. Link in bio.
hook: What if your wall cost $40 USD and weighed nothing?
visual_prompt: Close-up of hands pressing AR mesh into fresh cement on XPS foam — warm concrete tones, overhead architectural shot, low light, editorial
short_video_script: Open: hands cutting XPS foam with utility knife. Cut: applying mesh. Cut: troweling mortar over mesh. Cut: finished panel — knuckle tap sound. Text: 'Foam-Core Cement Panel — free guide at Infinite Architecture'

caption: Barrel roofs built with cattle panel and ferrocement mortar. Thin shell. Beautiful curve. 30-50 year lifespan. The ancient system that still works. ⚠️ Requires engineering review for inhabited spaces — full safety guide on Infinite Architecture.
hook: You can build this curved roof with cattle panel and cement.
visual_prompt: Wide-angle shot of ferrocement barrel roof exterior — warm golden light, tropical vegetation, raw concrete texture visible
short_video_script: Time-lapse: bending cattle panel to barrel curve. Applying diamond mesh layers. Pressing mortar through. Final barrel vault — pan from inside showing the curve.
